EuropeanDisabilityCard.name: European Disability Card
EuropeanDisabilityCard.INVALID.title: Your European Disability Card is not currently valid
EuropeanDisabilityCard.INVALID.descripti:
At the moment, you are unable to access the discounted services reserved for cardholders.

If your card has expired, you can renew your European Disability Card by contacting the issuing authority. Please check the required procedure on the INPS website or with your local health authority, as it may vary depending on the type of disability and local regulations.

If you need assistance, you can use the Inps Risponde service by signing in to the MyINPS reserved area on the www.inps.it portal or by using the INPS Mobile app.
EuropeanHealthInsuranceCard.name: European Health Insurance Card
EuropeanHealthInsuranceCard.INVALID.titl: Your European Health Insurance Card is not valid right now
EuropeanHealthInsuranceCard.INVALID.desc:
Your European Health Insurance Card may have expired or been revoked.

Your card is renewed automatically and sent to the address registered with the Italian Revenue Agency. If you have already received the new card, remove the old document from your wallet and add it again to update it.

For more information or to report any issues, please contact the responsible authority.

mDL.name: Mobile Driving License
Your Mobile Driving License is expired
You are currently unable to drive the vehicle categories associated with your license. Renew your license at the Department of Motor Vehicles or an authorized agency in your area.
mDL.INVALID.title: Your Mobile Driving License is not currently valid
mDL.INVALID.description:
You are currently not allowed to drive the vehicle categories listed on your Mobile Driving License. For example, your license may have been revoked or cancelled. Please contact the Civil Motorization Department for more information.

If you have already renewed your physical driving license, remove your digital document from the IO app and add it again.

**Remember: you can still use your Mobile Driving License as a form of identification.**
mDL.SUSPENDED.title: Your Mobile Driving License is not currently valid
mDL.SUSPENDED.description:
You are currently not allowed to drive the vehicle categories listed on your Mobile Driving License.

For example, your license may have been suspended or temporarily withdrawn. Please contact the Civil Motorization Department for more information.

Once your physical driving license becomes valid again, your digital document will update automatically.

**Remember: you can still use your Mobile Driving License as a form of identification.**
